explanation: Gulf business culture tends to be relaxed about strict scheduling, and it's common for Emirati counterparts to run a little late or extend small talk and coffee before getting to business. Foreign visitors, however, are still expected to arrive on time themselves as a sign of respect, since the relaxed local pace doesn't extend the same way to guests.
local_tip: Arrive on time yourself even if you expect to wait, and don't show irritation if your host is delayed.

also_check.note: Punctuality is taken very seriously, and arriving even a few minutes late is considered disrespectful.
Strict punctuality is the norm, and lateness is viewed as unprofessional.
Arriving 15-30 minutes late to a business meeting is common and generally unremarkable.
